_comment: Every number of the wider, deeper sand ocean (prompt 22). Regenerate with: node tools/rewrite/gen.js (extract-vanilla.sh once first). sea_level stays vanilla 63 in the noise settings (one number: sea_level in tools/rewrite/gen.js output, i.e. set ns.sea_level there).

_notes.ocean_bias: added to vanilla continentalness after the noise; lower = more ocean. -0.30 gives 72.8% ocean in the model (vanilla 49.2%).
_notes.continent_scale: xz_scale of the continentalness noise (vanilla 0.25). 0.20 = larger landmasses, 0.30 = smaller.
_notes.floor_y: nominal sea-floor height of the deepest ocean (smooth part of the terrain: y = 128 * offset + 128, before factor and the 3D noise).
_notes.shelf_width_blocks: horizontal length of the ramp from the floor up to vanilla's shelf height (y 48 at continentalness -0.18), converted to a continentalness range with shelf_gradient_per_block (median |grad c| over the ocean band, measured in tools/model).
_notes.shelf_end_continentalness: where the ramp meets vanilla's spline (vanilla value -0.12 = y 48). Everything at or above this continentalness is vanilla.
